name: Crustation
description: A control panel for Minecraft, Rust, Enshrouded and RuneScape: Dragonwilds servers. One binary supervises the game servers and serves a web interface, so there is no Docker socket to expose and everything lives in the three folders you map below. Create Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Fabric, NeoForge and Bedrock servers, Rust through SteamCMD with Oxide or Carbon, and Enshrouded and Dragonwilds through SteamCMD too. Each server gets a live console, players, chat, files, schedules and settings. The roadmap is in the GitHub repository. First sign-in: set the admin username and password below, or leave them empty and read the generated password from first-login.txt in the config folder. Java 8, 11, 17, 21 and 25 are included, and each Minecraft server starts on the one its version asks for. The Steam games need an amd64 host. Enshrouded only ships for Windows, so the image runs it under Wine. Rust wants around 8 GB of memory per server, Enshrouded around 16 GB, and Dragonwilds 2 GB plus 1 GB a player. Forward the game ports your servers need; the defaults for Minecraft Java, Bedrock and one server of each Steam game are mapped below. Stopping the container stops every game server first so each can save, which is why the stop timeout in Extra Parameters is 120 seconds.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Database, settings and the first-login file.

paths.name: Servers
paths.description: Where game server files live. Put this on a share with room to grow.

ports.name: Web interface
ports.description: Port for the Crustation web interface.

ports.name: Minecraft Java
ports.description: Default port for a Minecraft Java server.

ports.name: Minecraft Bedrock
ports.description: Default port for a Minecraft Bedrock server.

ports.name: Extra server ports
ports.description: Port range for additional game servers.

ports.name: Rust game
ports.description: Game port for the first Rust server.

ports.name: Rust query
ports.description: Steam query port for the first Rust server, two above its game port.

ports.name: Rust+ app
ports.description: Port the Rust+ phone app reaches the first Rust server on, the game port plus 68.

ports.name: Enshrouded
ports.description: Game and server list port for the first Enshrouded server. The standalone Enshrouded container uses it too, so only one of them can map it.

ports.name: Dragonwilds game
ports.description: Game port for the first Dragonwilds server. Keep the host port the same as the container port, or players are sent back to the title screen. The standalone Dragonwilds container uses it too.

ports.name: Dragonwilds beacon
ports.description: World settings beacon for the first Dragonwilds server, the game port plus 1111. Keep the host port the same as the container port.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: Username for the first administrator. Only used on the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Password for the first administrator, at least 10 characters. Leave empty to have one generated into first-login.txt.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone for logs and schedules, for example Europe/London.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id that owns the files. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id that owns the files. 100 is users on Unraid.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Full external address when behind a reverse proxy, for example https://panel.example.com. Turns on secure cookies.
